subject: gk
question: As on 2019, which is the largest multinational bank company in the world as measured by total assets?

options.text: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China

solution:
The correct answer is __**Industrial and Commercial Bank of China.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The largest bank in the world in terms of total assets under management (AUM) is the **Industrial and Commercial Bank Of China Ltd.**
 
• This institution provides credit cards and loans, financing for businesses, and money management services for companies and high net worth individuals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• SBI is the 43rd largest bank in the world and ranked 236th in the Fortune Global 500 list of the world's biggest corporations of 2019.
 
• The bank descends from the Bank of Calcutta, founded in 1806 via the Imperial Bank of India, making it the oldest commercial bank in the Indian subcontinent.
 
• It is the largest commercial bank in India.
